key_idea: Simulate the queue: arriving at minute i behind q leftover people and the a_i newcomers means waiting floor((q+a_i)/c) minutes.
sketch: Keep the queue length q before each minute; at minute i the number ahead of you is q+a_i, your wait is w=(q+a_i)/c and you board at minute i+w, which must be <= n-1 or the option is invalid. Take the strictly smallest w to get the earliest minute; then q = max(0, q+a_i-c). O(n). Pitfalls: 64-bit queue (up to 1e14), the last carriage leaves at minute n-1, and print impossible when no minute is feasible.
